inputs.locator: Decision feature: complete UTC-day MFI14. For each target day compute typical price as daily high plus low plus close divided by three and raw money flow as typical price times daily base volume. Across exactly target day D-13 through D, classify each flow positive when typical price exceeds its predecessor, negative when below and neither when equal, using D-14 as the predecessor for D-13. MFI is 100 times positive flow divided by positive plus negative flow, or exactly zero when that denominator is zero. Execute long only when completed-day MFI is strictly above the frozen threshold at the next H1 open.

Frozen variants and accounting: primary threshold 50 and rejection-only 45 and 55, all at fourteen complete days. Design is 2020-2022, historical Validation 2023-2024 and fair-reset annual folds 2020-2024. Candidate and buy-and-hold use equity one, zero-yield cash, no leverage or shorting, normal cost 10 bps fee plus 5 bps adverse slippage each side and stress cost 20 plus 10 bps.

Frozen all-pass gates: positive normal and stress returns; Design drawdown at most 95 percent of buy-and-hold and Calmar at least buy-and-hold; Validation drawdown at most 90 percent, upside capture at least 60 percent, Calmar at least buy-and-hold, 2 to 250 position changes, stress drawdown at most normal plus 3pp, positive terminal-liquidation return and cost at most 1pp; both neighbors positive under both costs with non-worse drawdown, at least 75 percent Calmar and 50 percent upside capture; annual normal and stress positive at least 4/5, drawdown non-worse 4/5, Calmar breadth 3/5, upside breadth 4/5, top-year and top-episode contribution at most 60 percent, P90 and terminal holding at most 17520 hours.

objective: Evaluate exactly one frozen MFI14 midline BTC long-or-zero-yield-cash policy on the sealed pre-2025 H1 corpus. Compare primary 50 and rejection-only 45 and 55 thresholds with full-capital buy-and-hold under identical normal and stress costs. Freeze a historical candidate only if every Design, Validation, annual breadth, concentration, drawdown, holding and terminal-inventory gate passes; otherwise permanently close the exact family without tuning. This is historical development evidence, not OOS or Trading authorization.

performance_case.causal_mechanism: MFI14 distinguishes typical-price moves accompanied by larger positive raw money flow from close-only momentum and cumulative or close-location volume indicators before the next-open decision.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may establish only one pre-2025 historical Design and Validation decision for exact MFI14 thresholds 45, 50 and 55. It cannot inspect post-2024 data, tune any formula or gate, substitute a neighbor, create Trading behavior, activate a strategy or open OOS unless every frozen gate passes.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: The policy is valuable only if it reduces adverse exposure enough to meet strict drawdown and Calmar gates without sacrificing required upside, hiding losses in terminal inventory or concentrating gains in one year or episode.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: The filter may miss profitable low-volume trends and can overtrade near the equal-flow boundary. One frozen screen either produces a historical candidate for independent OOS or closes the exact family before more source, threshold or runtime work consumes capacity.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The primary MFI14 above 50 state improves after-cost risk-adjusted performance versus matched full-capital buy-and-hold in both Design and historical Validation, with stable 45 and 55 neighbors and broad annual support.

decision_time.availability_rule: All daily high, low, close and base-volume inputs through completed day D and predecessor D-14 are known before the next H1 open; no incomplete day or later bar is used.

stop_conditions: Before outcome access, validate exact task, dispatch, intent and strategy path; rehash all non-null inputs and require clean HEAD equal to origin. Any failure is BTC_DAILY_MFI14_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT.
Require corpus SHA-256 e436a5a2b093365886464dd3e471cc5cd55c54bd2c06ceaa898ac218c45436dd, 52608 contiguous finite H1 rows and 2192 complete UTC days. Do not repair a failure.
Use only primary 50 and rejection-only 45 and 55 with exact MFI14 formula, costs, windows and gates. Do not inspect any alternative.
Run the frozen runner twice to new create-only outputs and require byte-identical SHA-256 results.
Return the positive disposition only if every frozen gate passes; otherwise valid economics returns BTC_DAILY_MFI14_FAMILY_CLOSE without tuning.
A positive result remains historical and REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED. It authorizes at most one independent sealed OOS and no Trading action.
